The role focuses on developing Azure-native application pipelines (Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus), integrating external security services, and enabling automated incident handling workflows in Microsoft Sentinel and Azure Data Explorer (ADX). Key deliverables include the CheckMail phishing analysis automation, MISP threat intelligence connector, SQL-based data replication, and complex Sentinel incident orchestration. This role is distinct from the Platform Engineer role: while the Engineer maintains infrastructure and platform operations, the Developer builds the custom application layer that runs on top of it as well as infrastructure components with larger code aspects.

At Bayer, we are committed to transparency, equal pay for equal work or work of equal value, and objective reward practices in line with EU and local regulations. The minimum monthly gross compensation for this role is 15 360 PLN, with final pay determined based on objective factors such as experience, qualifications, scope of responsibility, and internal alignment. This position is eligible for variable pay components, such as performance based bonuses, awarded in accordance with the applicable employee group, role scope, and compensation structure.

Your Tasks & Responsibilities:

Develop and maintain the Checkmail automation pipeline- an Azure-native application for automated analysis, enrichment, LLM-based classification, and escalation of user-reported phishing emails, including Function Apps (Python), Logic Apps, Service Bus integration, ADX data persistence, and Sentinel incident creation
Implement and operate the MISP2Sentinel threat intelligence connector- Azure Function App (Python) using PyMISP and MISP-STIX libraries to periodically push IoCs from DCSO-hosted MISP to the Sentinel Threat IntelligenceIndicator table via Upload Indicators API
Develop Azure Function Apps (Python) for SQL-based data replication- building and maintaining data pipelines between Azure SQL Database, ADX, and Sentinel to provide context data for detection and enrichment workflows
Design and implement complex security incident handling logic in Microsoft Sentinel- including multi-step enrichment workflows (VirusTotal, URLScan, CrowdStrike Sandbox), Analytics Rules, Automation Rules, and Logic App-based orchestration for SOC triage and ServiceNow ticketing
Integrate external security APIs and services into the SIEM platform- including enrichment providers, sandbox integrations, and threat intelligence feeds, with proper error handling, retry logic, and Dead Letter Queue management
Follow and contribute to the established IaaC deployment process- all application code and infrastructure deployed via GitHub Actions, Terraform, and the CSM GitHub repositories
Ensure application reliability and observability- implement structured logging, health monitoring integration, Application Insights instrumentation, and proactive alerting for all developed components
Support content handover and knowledge transfer- ensure all developed components are documented, follow CSM naming conventions, and are integrated into the established RBAC and deployment model
Collaborate with CSM analysts to translate detection and automation requirements into scalable, maintainable application code.

Experience with Azure PaaS services: Function Apps, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Key Vault, Event Hub, Application Insights

Vi är Drake Analytics – och vi tar hand om er data. Vi hjälper företag och organisationer att använda sin data strategiskt, skapa förståelse och insikter, och lösa komplexa affärsproblem. Bentley Systems is seeking a polyglot Senior Software Engineer to join a newly established, high-velocity Strategic Initiatives engineering squad operating directly within the Office of the CTO. The role sits at the intersection of engineering, architecture, and innovation, helping teams across Bentley resolve technical unknowns and move important initiatives forward. You'll have the autonomy to lead your own work, backed by the experience and collaboration of senior architects and engineers in the Office of the CTO. Your mission will be to build proof-of-concepts, experiment with emerging technologies like AI, and tackle complex challenges in distributed systems and cloud-native architecture.

You will be instrumental in shaping the future of Bentley's products and platforms, working on everything from modernizing existing systems to creating entirely new solutions. This role offers a unique opportunity to work with a high degree of autonomy, collaborate with senior architects, and make a tangible impact on Bentley's strategic initiatives.

Responsibilities

Architect, implement, and benchmark functional proof-of-concepts (PoCs) to accelerate and de-risk complex technical hurdles, validate performance, and evaluate emerging technologies before company-wide commitment.
Partner directly with executive technical leadership on exploratory engineering problems—translating open-ended concepts and ambiguous requirements into functional, testable software.
Move fluidly across technical domains depending on project needs, from deep performance profiling, memory optimization, and cloud reliability bottlenecks to microservices, APIs, and modern front-end spikes.
Take vague, high-level problem briefs and independently explore viable technical paths, establishing clarity and actionable solutions with minimal direction.
Package validated prototypes, architectural findings, and performance data into clean, maintainable deliverables so domain teams can seamlessly transition solutions into production.
Actively integrate modern AI-assisted engineering workflows (e.g., Claude, Copilot, Gemini, vector indexing/RAG architectures) into day-to-day development to shorten research cycles, accelerate code generation, and test hypotheses faster.

Qualifications

7+ years software engineering experience with a demonstrable track record of designing, building, and delivering complex, high-performance software in fast-paced, product-led environments.
Working fluency across multiple programming languages (such as C#, TypeScript, Python, Java, or C++), with the aptitude to pick the best tool for the specific problem at hand.
Solid foundational knowledge of distributed systems, multi-tenant patterns, containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes), and at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
Hands-on experience investigating performance bottlenecks, concurrency issues, memory leaks, latency profiling, and network reliability.
Highly self-directed and comfortable operating autonomously without extensive supervision.
Practical experience leveraging generative AI APIs, vector retrieval/RAG patterns, or daily integration of AI-assisted engineering tools to amplify output.
Ability to synthesize complex technical discoveries, trade-offs, and architectural recommendations into direct, high-signal summaries for technical leadership.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

What We Offer

A great Team and culture – please see our colleague video.
An exciting career as an integral part of a world-leading software company providing solutions for architecture, engineering, and construction - watch this short documentary about how we got our start.
An attractive salary and benefits package.
A commitment to inclusion, belonging and colleague wellbeing through global initiatives and resource groups.
A company committed to making a real difference by advancing the world’s infrastructure for better quality of life, where your contributions help build a more sustainable, connected, and resilient world. Discover our latest user success stories for an insight into our global impact.

Around the world, infrastructure professionals rely on software from Bentley Systems to help them design, build, and operate better and more resilient infrastructure for transportation, water, energy, cities, and more. jobs.location: Aarhus Municipality, Central Denmark Region, Denmark
jobs.description:
Du bliver en del af Professional Services (PS) – vores forretningsenhed, der arbejder med digitalisering og teknologiske løsninger inden for ERP, CRM, Microsoft 365, Business Intelligence, Cyber Consultancy, Custom Built Solutions og AI.

I forretningsområdet Custom Built Solutions vil du indgå i vores Products-team, der udvikler og driver Danmarks førende elektroniske patientjournalsystem til den kommunale tandpleje. Vi søger en full-stack Developer med særligt fokus på frontend-udvikling. Samtidig skal du blive motiveret af at arbejde med videreudvikling og forbedring af et veletableret system, som hver dag understøtter arbejdet i den kommunale tandpleje i samarbejde med dygtige kollegaer.

Du bliver tilknyttet vores kontor i Viby eller Nordhavn med mulighed for hjemmearbejde. Du kan dog forvente periodisk mødeaktivitet på begge lokationer.

Din rolle

Som Developer kommer du til at arbejde med videreudvikling og vedligeholdelse af vores system til den kommunale tandpleje. Rollen har primært fokus på frontend-udvikling og integrationer til øvrige systemer, men du kommer også til at være involveret i prioritering af produktudvikling, test, fejlsøgning og dokumentation sammen med resten af det stærke team omkring produktet. Du vil få et tæt samarbejde med resten af teamet bl.a. bestående af produktkonsulenter, supportere og andre udviklere, hvor alle har et stærkt ønske om at forbedre og styrke systemets funktionaliteter og sikre glade kunder. Vi løfter i fællesskab, og derfor er det væsentligt, at du er en holdspiller.

Derudover kan rollen også indebære dialog og sparring med kunder – både over for tekniske og ikke-tekniske interessenter. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du trives i rollen som sparringspartner og kan omsætte og formidle tekniske løsninger i et sprog, der giver mening for brugerne og for dine kollegaer i teamet.

Dine primære ansvarsområder dækker over følgende:

Afdække kundernes forretningsbehov og omsætte dem til tekniske løsninger og systemfunktioner.
Fejlsøge og forbedre eksisterende integrationer for at sikre stabil dataudveksling.
Udvikle nye frontend-funktioner til systemet.
Vedligeholde og optimere eksisterende kodebase for at sikre stabil drift og høj performance.
Bidrage til teknisk sparring i forbindelse med design af nye funktioner.
Udarbejde og gennemføre tests af nye funktioner og integrationer.
Udarbejde teknisk dokumentation af nye funktioner, integrationer og systemændringer.

Vi søger en teamm8 der

Ønsker en rolle med fokus på både nyudvikling og vedligeholdelse af et anerkendt system inden for et nicheområde. Derudover ser vi gerne at følgende er opfyldt:

3-5 års erfaring fra en rolle som udvikler særligt med fokus på frontend-udvikling, hvor du eventuelt har arbejdet med Middleware, Unit-testing og/eller CI/CD.
Gerne viden om WinForms, .Net Framework/.Net Core, SQL Server, Git og/eller Azure DevOps.
Evner at forklare kompleks kode i et sprog som kollegaer og kunder forstår.
Motiveres i kundedialoger og behovsafdækning, som herefter omsættes til konkrete løsninger.
Behersker dansk og engelsk både mundtligt og skriftligt.

Det du får

En unik mulighed for at arbejde med softwareudvikling i et nichesystem, der er anerkendt i markedet.
Mulighed for tage ansvar i en udviklingsrolle af teknisk karakter, hvor du formår at spille systemets brugere gode med rette rådgivning.
At blive en del af en hybrid arbejdsplads med mulighed for hjemmearbejde.
Indgå i en kultur med ambitioner, ærlighed og plads til personlig udvikling
At blive en del af en ambitiøs IT-koncern med 1600 teamm8s, der hepper på dig.

Skal du med på holdet?

Så ser vi frem til at modtage dit CV.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Stefanie Kerstin Krüger Holtum, Manager - Custom Built Solutions på skkru@itm8.com. Alle henvendelser behandles fortroligt.

Vi afholder løbende samtaler og afslutter rekrutteringsprocessen, når den rette kandidat er fundet. Vi indhenter straffeattest forud for ansættelse.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

Om itm8

Vi er itm8 – vores kunders IT-mate.

Bag os står 1.600+ teammates fordelt på Danmark, Sverige, Filippinerne og Tjekkiet. Med specialister inden for alt fra IT-sikkerhed og ERP til AI og softwareudvikling.

Men det, der binder os sammen, er ikke kun teknologi. Det er PURPLE POWER – vores måde at arbejde på. Her hjælper vi hinanden først, fejrer det der virker, og skærer igennem bullshit. Vi tror på ambition frem for status quo. Og på at forskellighed gør os stærkere.

Hos os handler det ikke om at være perfekt. Men om at tage ansvar, skabe værdi og udvikle sig – hver dag.

Så spørg dig selv: Hvad kan du bygge i dag? Hvor kan det tage os i morgen?

Lyder det som dig? Så søg – og bliv vores næste team'm8.

Experience working with relational databases (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or similar) and ORMs (Entity Framework or equivalent)
Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and CI/CD pipelines
Experience with version control (Git) and collaborative development workflows
Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills

Experience integrating enterprise systems with enterprise directory services or similar identity providers

Exposure to hybrid environments where .NET services, Node/React front ends, and Python-based automation coexist and need to interoperate
A track record of improving reliability, security, or maintainability of backend systems in a production environment

jobs.title: Global Technology Summer Analyst (Software Engineer) - 2027 - Singapore
jobs.description:
What we’re looking for:

Penultimate year Undergraduate/Master’s student seeking a summer internship with the opportunity for 2028 full-time conversion
Majoring in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems or a related area
Strong programming foundation in OOP and knowledge of platforms such as UNIX, Windows, databases, Java, C, C++, C#, .NET and other technologies
Strong quantitative and analytical skills
Effective verbal and written communication
Being comfortable with change and able to adjust to changing demands and requirements
Strong team player and client-focused
Demonstrate energy and drive
Show a keen interest and passion in Computing and Technology

Why Us?

Bank of America’s strategic vision is to deliver market-leading technology that drives our business forward and meets the needs of our clients. Our business-aligned technology teams develop and support the software platforms critical to that goal. These cover the full spectrum of our business including sales, trading and research applications, trade processing, risk management and portfolio management.

In order to maintain our competitive edge and deliver the best solutions to our global client base, we continually invest in cutting-edge technology, including artificial intelligence (AI). Global Technology embeds AI into how we build, run and protect our company’s platforms, reflecting a culture of responsible innovation. As a member of our team, you’ll use leading AI-enabled technology solutions and integrated platforms to help customers and clients manage their financial lives and bank with us anytime, anywhere. The global nature of our business offers you the opportunity to work and interact with colleagues from around the world, supporting an expanding product range and high level of global demand.

This Summer Analyst Program offers Software Engineer role in the Global Markets Technology divisions. This division provides technology solutions and strategic support to the equities, electronic trading, rates and currencies, credit and structured products, commodities, sales and capital markets businesses.

Global Markets Technology (GMT) – Provides technology solutions and support to Global Markets business. GMT includes Global Equity Technology - Leads the three primary businesses, active in 140 markets around the world: Execution Services (high and low touch), Client Solutions (derivatives) and Asset Management Services (prime brokerage, security lending and swaps). In addition, this group also covers Global Sales, Research, Capital Markets and the GBAM Mercury® Portal. Fixed Income, Currencies and Commodities (FICC) Technology - Supports FICC trading and sales franchise that operates out of 25 locations worldwide, covering clients in more than 150 countries. Global Markets Operations Technology - Supports Global Markets Operations and Middle Office, plus external partners. Acts as the primary support for Global Markets Operations across Transaction Management, Confirmations, Settlements & Clearing, Corporate Actions, Payments, Operational Risk, P&L and Balance Sheet, and Reference Data. They also provide support for Futures and Options, OTC Clearing, FXPB and GCAS Front Offices.

What you’ll do:

Key tasks and responsibilities may include, but are not limited to:

Provide technical excellence to design, develop, and maintain state-of-the-art technology applications utilizing technologies such as Java/EJB’s, C++, .NET, Python and Web services
Gather and translate internal and external client requirements into technical design specifications, business process reengineering
Code solutions, unit tests, and ensures the solution can be integrated successfully into the overall application/system with clear, robust, and well-tested interfaces
Participates and contributes to the delivery/release (CI/CD) events. e.g. branching timelines, pull requests, issue triage, merge/conflict resolution, release notes

Program Overview

Our Summer Program is a 10-week program designed to provide you with a unique experience based on your interests, development opportunities and current business needs. Analyst positions support teams that work on the latest technology and emerging technical trends. The Summer program begins with an orientation and induction to the firm. You will have access to valuable on-the-job support, opportunities to connect with senior leaders and the ability to attend various networking and developmental events.

Summer Analysts are given a true associate experience, as assignments mirror full-time responsibility and include goal-setting and a formal review process.

Your internship opportunity could include:

Access to the bank’s learning hub containing a variety of learning resources, ranging from banking fundamentals to communication skills
Structured and on-the-job training
Networking and social opportunities
Speaker series with senior management across all lines of business
Corporate Social Responsibility project/learning
Involvement in Opportunity and Inclusion training/events
Consideration for full-time employment upon graduation

Here at Bank of America, our focus is on providing our clients with innovative, safe, and secure solutions by leveraging the most advanced technology tools, coupled with the creativity of our technology teams.

About Us

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. Responsible Growth is how we run our company and how we deliver for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

One of the keys to driving Responsible Growth is being a great place to work for our teammates around the world. We’re devoted to being an inclusive workplace for everyone. We hire individuals with a broad range of backgrounds and experiences and invest heavily in our teammates and their families by offering competitive benefits to support their physical, emotional, and financial well-being.

Bank of America believes both in the importance of working together and offering flexibility to our employees. We use a multi-faceted approach for flexibility, depending on the various roles in our organization.

Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!

Connecting Asia Pacific to the World

Our Asia Pacific team is spread across 19 cities in 12 markets. We are focused on connecting Asia to the world and the world to Asia, using our global expertise to ensure success is shared between us, our clients and our communities. Our regional footprint covers 12 currencies, more than a dozen languages and five time zones, placing us firmly among the region’s leading financial services companies.

Assist the support team with troubleshooting and resolution of issues reported on production systems
Participate in the product research and development process by providing the engineering team with new solutions and ideas based on project experience
Generate ideas for innovative technological solutions to increase the quality of Suvoda system
Perform other related duties as required

Bachelor’s degree preferred
At least 2 years of experience in a similar role
Prior working experience in developing web applications with C#, .NET (Framework or Core), SQL Server, Model View Controller (MVC) and Entity Framework (EF)
High achieving personality
Desire to learn and grow
Strong work ethic

Our R&D division is a diverse, multicultural team of experienced professionals, all driven by a shared commitment to delivering technical excellence. The R&D team operates across Romania, France, UK, US, Canada, Czech Republic, Germany, and Poland, in close collaboration with our Product Management team to create industry-leading solutions for the AEC sector.

GRAITEC fosters a rewarding work environment that values continuous learning, personal initiative, and the freedom to contribute innovative ideas to support company success.

Overview

As a Full Stack Software Developer
, you will join GRAITEC's R&D organization and contribute to the development of software solutions used by construction, engineering, and design professionals around the world. Our products support the digital transformation of the Architecture, Engineering & Construction (AEC) industry, helping customers design, collaborate, and deliver complex projects more efficiently.

You will work in a modern technology ecosystem that combines desktop applications, web platforms, cloud services, and integrated engineering solutions. As part of a cross-functional Agile team, you will be involved in the complete software development lifecycle, from technical design and development through testing, deployment, maintenance, and continuous improvement.
This role offers a strong balance between back-end and front-end development. While the primary focus is on building scalable and maintainable solutions using C# and .NET
, you will also contribute to modern user experiences and web applications developed with React, JavaScript, and TypeScript
.
Working closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, QA Engineers, Cloud & DevOps specialists, and other Software Engineers, you will help deliver secure, high-performing, and reliable software solutions. Experience working with microservices architectures and distributed systems.
Experience working with cloud services, preferably Microsoft Azure (AWS or Google Cloud Platform are also valued).
Experience working with relational databases and SQL.
Experience with CI/CD practices, source control systems, and modern software delivery processes.
Experience working throughout the full software development lifecycle, from design and implementation to testing, deployment, and production support.
Experience working in Agile development environments and collaborating with cross-functional teams.

Nice to Have Experience
Experience developing modern web applications using React.
Experience working with JavaScript and TypeScript.
Experience with containerized environments and technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes.
Experience integrating AI-powered services or using AI-assisted development tools.
Experience developing software solutions for the Architecture, Engineering, Construction (AEC), BIM, CAD, or related industries.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.

jobs.title: Medior/Senior Back End Developer C# .NET
jobs.description:
Keytrade Bank
is a young and dynamic bank where IT systems were traditionally developed in-house. Today, we are evolving towards a model focused on customer experience and innovation, combining in-house solutions with off-the-shelf products and services for core functionalities.
Where responsibilities used to be organized by technical skills, we now structure them by business domain, called Feature Teams .
Building new products requires close collaboration across back-end, front-end, database, infrastructure, vendors, and service providers.
Working in a smaller bank means broader responsibilities, wider knowledge, and the opportunity to make a real impact. We are growing fast and are looking for motivated people eager to join our teams to help transform and improve our trading and banking systems.
What makes the position interesting?

You will work on a distributed .NET platform built around C# / .NET, Domain-Driven Design and event-driven microservices.
Our services communicate through gRPC and asynchronous messaging using RabbitMQ and NServiceBus, applying patterns such as CQRS, Domain Events, Outbox, etc.
You will be involved not only in development, but also in domain modelling, technical design, architecture decisions and the continuous evolution of our distributed systems.
The platform runs on AWS and Kubernetes (EKS) and uses MySQL/Aurora and DynamoDB, depending on the domain and its access patterns.
We put a strong emphasis on engineering quality, automated testing, observability and production readiness.
Infrastructure and delivery are managed through GitLab CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes and Terraform.
The role offers the opportunity to work on real-world distributed systems where reliability, scalability, maintainability and domain complexity matter, rather than simply building CRUD applications.
You will not only work with interesting technologies, but also solve complex problems across three key business domains:
Banking
– everything related to payments and banking transactions.
Cards
– debit and credit card ordering and management.
Credits
– primarily our online mortgage product, Keyhome
.

Profile

You are a passionate developer who enjoys:
Being a true team player, sharing knowledge and supporting colleagues, while also being able to drive initiatives autonomously.
Transforming complex business needs into elegant and maintainable technical solutions.
Balancing engineering discipline with pragmatism.
Caring deeply about code quality, security and maintainability.
Continuously learning, both from a technical perspective and about the banking domain.
Participating in technical design, domain modelling, architecture decisions and the evolution of distributed systems.
Working in a Scrum environment.

Our working environment is mainly English-speaking, and you are fluent in English. Dutch and French are considered an asset but are not mandatory.

As an experienced .NET/C# developer, you have solid experience with:
C# / .NET 8/.NET 10
Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
REST API: consuming, designing and building APIs
Messaging/Event-driven architecture: commands, events, asynchronous communication
RabbitMQ
Clean Code and SOLID principles
Microservices architecture
Distributed systems: idempotency, retries, failure handling
Automated testing: unit and integration testing, TDD, xUnit, Moq, AutoFixture
Containerization – Docker
Relational Database, transactions, queries and ORM

We also use these technologies, and we would appreciate if you master them, but if you do not have experience with them, we will help you get up to speed with them:
NServiceBus
Kafka
Amazon Web Services (S3, DynamoDB, KMS, Api Gateway, EKS…)
gRPC/protobuf
OpenTelemetry
Serilog
Dynatrace

GitLab CI/CD

Agile way of working

We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat voor developer je bent. Waar krijg je energie van? Duik je graag diep in backendvraagstukken? Werk je graag aan APIs? Denk je graag mee over architectuur? Of krijg je net energie van een omgeving waar je breder kunt meedenken dan alleen de code die voor je neus ligt?

Binnen Cronos bestaat namelijk niet zoiets als dé .NET job.

Er zijn verschillende bedrijven, teams en omgevingen. Daarom willen we je liever niet in één vacature proberen te duwen. We horen liever eerst jouw verhaal en kijken daarna waar binnen Cronos een interessante match kan zitten.

, je hebt gewerkt met moderne frontendtechnologie
zoals Vue, Angular of React, en je hebt minstens enige ervaring met cloud, bij voorkeur Azure
.

Daarbovenop wordt het interessant als je ook al gewerkt hebt met zaken als CI/CD, microservices, containers, Blazor, cloud native development
of verschillende architectuurprincipes.

jobs.description:
Sobre el puesto

Buscamos un/a Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Python) para incorporarse a un proyecto de una compañía internacional líder en soluciones de gestión de nóminas y RRHH. Formarás parte del equipo que desarrolla una plataforma de Payroll Operations potenciada por IA: un asistente inteligente que automatiza los flujos de nómina y permite a los profesionales gestionar sus operaciones a través de una experiencia conversacional.
No es un proyecto greenfield: se espera que te incorpores rápidamente a un codebase grande y existente, entiendas cómo se conectan los sistemas y entregues dentro de los patrones y convenciones ya establecidos. La plataforma cubre todo el stack, desde micro frontends y web components, pasando por APIs REST y bases de datos relacionales, hasta agentes de IA desplegados en cloud, e integra múltiples sistemas de nómina enterprise.
¿Qué harás?

Diseñar, construir y mantener agentes de IA en Python utilizando frameworks agénticos modernos y runtimes de IA en cloud
Desarrollar y mantener APIs en .NET Core que actúan como servicios downstream de la capa de agentes
Construir e integrar micro frontends en Angular y web components en Stencil dentro de una shell application enterprise existente
Trabajar con bases de datos SQL Server: escribir queries, entender esquemas e integrarse con los modelos de datos de nómina existentes
Escribir y mantener código de infraestructura en Terraform para despliegues cloud
Integrar nuevas capacidades de agentes en sistemas legacy de nómina sin romper la funcionalidad existente
Colaborar con equipos de frontend, backend, IA e infraestructura para entregar funcionalidades end-to-end
Aplicar buenas prácticas de seguridad: trust boundaries de identidad, idempotencia, audit trails, redacción de PII y feature flags como kill switches
Contribuir a la documentación de diseño, READMEs y knowledge base del equipo

¿Qué buscamos?

5+ años de experiencia profesional en ingeniería de software, con al menos 2 años en sistemas full-stack (frontend, backend e infraestructura cloud)
IA / Agentes: runtimes de agentes en cloud (despliegue, configuración de memoria, gestión del runtime), frameworks agénticos (diseño de tools, patrones orchestrator/child agent, flujos human-in-the-loop), Model Context Protocol (MCP) en cliente y servidor, prompt engineering y patrones de diseño agénticos (state machines, HITL, intent routing)
Backend: Python 3.10+ a nivel avanzado (async, validación de datos, packaging), .NET Core / C# (APIs REST, implementación de servidores MCP) y SQL Server (esquemas, queries, stored procedures)
Frontend: Angular v15+ (module federation, micro frontends), Stencil.js, TypeScript avanzado y experiencia con design systems enterprise (librerías de componentes, tokens, accesibilidad)
Infraestructura y DevOps: Terraform (container registries, IAM, secrets management), Docker / Podman, AWS (servicios de contenedores, runtimes de IA, secrets, IAM), monorepos (NX o similar) y pipelines CI/CD
Seguridad y compliance: patrones zero-trust e identidad de tenant, diseño idempotente (claves deterministas, exactly-once), audit trails y redacción de PII, feature flags y kill switches

Perfil que encaja

Te pones productivo/a rápido en codebases grandes y desconocidos
Piensas en sistemas: puedes seguir una petición de frontend → API → agente de IA → infraestructura cloud y detectar dónde falla
Te sientes cómodo/a trabajando con sistemas legacy, no solo en proyectos desde cero
Lees antes de escribir: entiendes los patrones existentes antes de introducir nuevos
Autonomía para coger un ticket, encontrar el código relevante y entregar
Colaborador/a de bajo ego, que trabaja dentro de las decisiones arquitectónicas del equipo
Mentalidad de documentación: dejas el codebase mejor de lo que lo encontraste

Se valorará

Conocimiento del dominio de nómina o RRHH (centros de coste, estructuras organizativas, workforce management)
Experiencia con sistemas ERP o CRM enterprise legacy
Testing end-to-end / de integración (Playwright o similar)
Experiencia construyendo o integrando funcionalidades de IA conversacional o chatbots en aplicaciones enterprise
Experiencia integrando funcionalidades basadas en IA/LLMs en sistemas en producción

Nivel de inglés profesional, imprescindible (entorno de trabajo en inglés)
¿Qué ofrecemos?

✅ Horario flexible
✅ Modelo de trabajo híbrido, favoreciendo el equilibrio entre vida personal y profesional
✅ Salario competitivo y plan de retribución flexible

jobs.title: Solution Architect – Industrial Data & Integration
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

SistelGroup delivers turnkey PLC, SCADA and OT data contextualization solutions for the manufacturing industry. For more than 30 years we have helped pharmaceutical, chemical, and food & beverage manufacturers run plants that are more efficient, safer and fully traceable.
We work as a partner, not a supplier. We learn our customers’ processes, we stay with them through the full life of a solution, and we are the people they call when something matters. That is why our clients stay with us for decades.
When you join us, you will work on international projects with advanced Industry 4.0 and digitalization technologies for leading manufacturing companies. You will also build your career in a group that covers both industrial automation and digital transformation for the manufacturing industry.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a Solution Architect to lead the technical direction of our industrial data and integration work. This is a hands-on architecture role, focused on Unified Namespace, industrial connectivity and data contextualization. You will design and build the architectures that connect the plant floor to business systems (SCADA, MES, ERP, warehousing systems, LIMS), and you will write the reference architecture and the standards that our engineers follow. Ignition is a particular focus: it is the platform we build most of these solutions on.
You are hands-on with the technology. You build proofs of concept, prototypes and demonstrations: to prove a design works, to show a client what is possible, and to give our engineers a working reference to learn from. Our project teams carry out the implementation and commissioning, and part of the Solution Architect role is to train them to do it well.
Much of this work is about context. A plant produces millions of values every day, but a value on its own means very little. Context is what turns it into insightful information: which equipment produced it, on which line, during which batch and for which product, and how it connects to the order in the ERP system and the result in the laboratory. You design the models, the naming and the relationships that carry that meaning, so that the same data serves an operator, a quality reviewer and a data scientist without anyone having to guess what it refers to.
You will work with our commercial team from the first client conversations, helping turn a business problem into a design, a demonstration, and a proposal. On projects: you are involved in the early stages — design, architecture and the technical decisions that shape the work — and then hand over to the delivery team. Most of our clients work in regulated industries, which means clear documentation and traceable design decisions are key.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Architecture and design

Design Unified Namespace architectures for plant data: namespace and topic structure, information models, and the context that gives each value its meaning.
Design the data models behind the architecture: equipment and site hierarchies, product and batch genealogy, and the relationships between assets, processes and quality results, using recognized models ISA-95 and ISA-88.
Design integrations between plant systems and business systems: PLC, SCADA, ERP, MES, LIMS, historians and data platforms.
Assess legacy plant and laboratory environments and design the modernization path for them.
Choose the technologies, and write reference architecture and design standards for this work.

Proofs of concept and integration

Build proofs of concept, prototypes and reference implementations that prove a design works before a project commits to it.
Build and prove data flows with MQTT, Sparkplug B, OPC UA and REST APIs.
Work with Ignition and similar platforms as the plant-side layer of these architectures.
Build prototypes of data-driven applications on top of the architecture: equipment monitoring, predictive maintenance, and batch reporting.
Integrate with ERP and MES using standard message formats such as B2MML, so that production orders, confirmations and quality results flow in both directions.
Make plant data findable and “end user friendly” to people who did not build the system, through consistent naming, documented models and clear metadata.
Connect to business and laboratory systems: SAP and other ERP systems, MES platforms, LIMS and quality systems.

Pre-sales and client consulting

Work with our commercial team during early client conversations: understand the business problem before designing anything.
Run technical workshops with clients, design the solution, and present it clearly to both engineers and management.
Build the demonstrations and solution concepts that our commercial team uses in client meetings.
Contribute to development of technical proposals, solution designs and estimates together with our commercial team.

Technical expertise and knowledge sharing

Train engineers to implement and commission the solutions you design, and build the team’s capability in Ignition, MQTT, industrial data connectivity, and data contextualization concepts.
Lead the design phase of new projects, then hand over to the delivery team with the documentation and guidance they need.

REQUIREMENTS

Degree in engineering, computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
8+ years of experience in industrial automation, industrial software or IT/OT integration, including several years in an architecture or solution design role.
Deep hands-on experience with Ignition (Inductive Automation): you build prototypes and demonstrations yourself, and you are comfortable working in the tools rather than only specifying them.
Proven experience designing and integrating plant-to-enterprise architectures in real production environments: Unified Namespace, PLC, DCS, SCADA, MES, ERP and LIMS.
Strong experience with MQTT, Sparkplug B, OPC UA, and REST APIs.
Proven experience modelling and contextualizing industrial data: hierarchies, naming conventions, metadata and the relationships between equipment, process and product.
Strong SQL skills, and at least one scripting language, preferably Python.
Experience delivering in GMP or other regulated environments, with working knowledge of GAMP 5, EU GMP Annex 11, 21 CFR Part 11.
The ability to explain a complex architecture simply, to engineers and to managers.
Commercial skills: effort estimation, and technical workshop facilitation.
English, spoken and written. Spanish is a plus.

DESIRABLE EXPERIENCE AND CERTIFICATIONS

The following skills are nice-to-have and will support the innovative engineering initiatives at our company.
Data-driven manufacturing applications: predictive maintenance, equipment monitoring, OEE, energy monitoring solutions, batch reporting and yield, golden batch.
MQTT broker platforms: HiveMQ, or the Cirrus Link modules for Ignition.
Cloud knowledge, preferably Azure.
Historians and industrial data platforms: AVEVA OSI PI, AspenTech Inmation, or similar.
Time-series and non-relational databases (MongoDB, InfluxDB, or similar).
Containers, CI/CD and version control (Docker, Kubernetes, Git).
Data analysis and dashboards (Power BI, Grafana or similar).
OT network and security design: segmentation, industrial DMZ, and ISA/IEC 62443 knowledge or certification.
MES platforms: Ignition Sepasoft, Körber PAS-X, Siemens Opcenter, or similar.
Multi-site standardization, or defining a technical service offering: creating a reference architecture or data model template and rolling it out across several plants or projects.
Regulatory awareness for industrial data: the EU GMP Annex 11 revision, and Annex 22 on artificial intelligence in GMP.

WHAT WE OFFER

A builder’s role with technical ownership: you design it, you prove it, and you see it become part of how the company works.
Training programs with our technology partners.
A direct line to the business: you work with our commercial team and see your designs turn into won projects.
Large international pharmaceutical clients and genuinely complex plants.
A specialized and collaborative technical team, and 30+ years of plant knowledge behind you. We are a people-oriented company, with special focus on ensuring the best environment for our engineers to work and collaborate.
Competitive salary according to your experience.
Flexible working hours and hybrid work.

POSITION DETAILS

Vestas Technology & Operations > Research & Development (R&D) > Plant Design & Risk Modelling

Plant Design & Risk Modelling is anchored in Vestas R&D. Vestas R&D is where new product ideas and technologies are developed, matured, tested, and improved. As a cornerstone of Vestas, R&D plays a critical role in developing sustainable energy solutions.

The Plant Design & Risk Modelling department operates across two key areas: developing Vestas’ site assessment platform and advancing our risk offering and warranty framework. The department works in close collaboration with stakeholders across the Vestas value chain to deliver data-driven solutions that support both business performance and customer value creation. The team consists of highly skilled, international, and cross-disciplinary professionals based in Denmark and Portugal, bringing together diverse skills and perspectives.

We promote a culture of empowerment, enabling employees to make a meaningful contribution through their work. At the same time, we support individual performance and growth by promoting an inclusive, collaborative, and motivating work environment where diversity is valued, and teamwork is at the core of everything we do.

Responsibilities

Continuously develop and maintain one of Vestas' core simulation tools used for site-specific load evaluation
Decompose, modularize, and enhance scientific computation systems in close collaboration with domain experts, and integrate them into a highly scalable cloud environment
Develop well-structured, maintainable, and testable code, contributing to a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning
Collaborate closely with end users, business stakeholders, and the IT organization to understand needs and deliver impactful solutions
Participate in agile team practices, supporting continuous improvement in collaboration, processes, and ways of working
Interest in agile facilitation or a potential future path toward a Scrum Master role is considered an advantage

Qualifications

B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

Experience in software engineering and software architecture, including areas such as API design, system design, testability, and CI/CD pipelines
Experience working with service-oriented architectures and/or microservice-based architectures

Ability to understand and engage effectively with stakeholders across different domains and functions
A curious mindset with a willingness to explore and navigate complex technical domains and organizational landscapes
Effective communication skills, with the ability to collaborate efficiently with developers, users, and business stakeholders
A systems-thinking approach combined with a quality mindset
A team-oriented approach and the ability to thrive in a diverse and international environment
Ability to provide constructive feedback and support the team's continuous improvement
Fluency in English, both written and spoken

What We Offer

If you would like to join an innovative and international environment, with great possibilities for personal development and supportive colleagues, then Vestas and Plant Design & Risk Modelling offer just that. With 29,000 employees globally, we are a diverse team united by a common goal: to advance the solution - today, tomorrow, and far into the future. Join us in the mission for a more sustainable world.

This is a hybrid position based in Porto, Portugal. Applicants must be authorized to work in Portugal. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

We will be reviewing applications on a rolling basis, therefore, early applications are encouraged. To apply for this opportunity, please submit your CV in English.

At Vestas, we evaluate all candidates solely based on their professional experience, education, and relevant skills. To support a fair recruitment process, we kindly ask that you remove any photos, dates of birth or graduation, gender pronouns, marital status, or other personal information not relevant to the role before submitting your CV/resume. Your CV/resume should focus on your professional and educational background, along with the necessary contact details (email and phone number). We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Vestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore.

Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. Reporting to the Integrations Manager, you'll collaborate with external partners, lead developers, and compliance teams to design high-performance REST APIs. In this role, you'll provide high-level architectural guidance and conduct code reviews to ensure scalability, security, and maintainability. You'll translate complex technical hurdles into clear insights for executive leadership and cross-functional stakeholders. As a technical mentor, you'll support team growth, guide deployment strategies, and maintain clear communication during critical system alignment. Your technical leadership ensures our integration platform remains robust, elegant, and secure.

Lead and mentor engineering team members through architectural guidance and thorough code reviews
Design, build, and maintain high-performance REST APIs for data formats like XML, JSON, and SOAP
Manage end-to-end partner integration lifecycles from initial discovery to live, zero-downtime deployment

Refine internal development processes, champion TDD principles, and optimize the overall SDLC

Release Governance: Practical experience managing production deployments and overseeing the "Definition of Done."

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer / Developer
new_jobs.description:
Location:
Remote (UK, Ireland or Spain - must have right to work in one of these countries) 
Type:
Permanent, Full Time  

About IAM Cloud

IAM Cloud builds software that simplifies IT management in the cloud. We are a fully employee owned, bootstrapped company - which means we answer to our customers and our team, not investors. With around 35 employees, we serve more than 3,000 organisations worldwide.  

Being employee owned shapes how we work. Decisions are long-term, the culture is collaborative, and the people who build the company share in its success. We have leaned deliberately into AI and agentic workflows across the business as a core part of how a focused team competes with companies ten times our size. We are fully remote with employees in the UK, Ireland, Spain, Germany and Argentina and have been remote for years, as a deliberate choice about how good work gets done.

Role Overview

We are seeking an exceptional Senior Software Engineer / Developer to help solve some of the most complex technical challenges across our platform. This role is suited to a strong engineering-minded problem solver who can analyse difficult problems and connect the dots across the platform of our products, design robust solutions and deliver high quality software. You will play a key role in shaping architecture, improving platform capabilities and supporting future initiatives involving distributed systems, AI-enabled functionality, search technologies and large-scale APIs.  

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, test and maintain high quality software throughout the full development lifecycle.  
Solve complex technical and architectural challenges using sound engineering principles.  
Contribute to API, backend and cloud platform development using modern Microsoft technologies.  
Collaborate with product, engineering and leadership teams to deliver strategic initiatives.  
Analyse, diagnose and resolve difficult production and performance issues.  
Apply clean code, object-oriented design and software engineering best practices.  
Support technical decision making, code reviews and knowledge sharing across the team.  
Leverage AI tools appropriately to increase effectiveness whilst maintaining quality and ownership.  
Identify opportunities to improve systems, processes, scalability and reliability. 

Essential Requirements

Strong professional experience developing software with C# and modern .NET.  
Excellent understanding of software engineering fundamentals, algorithms, system design and problem solving.  
Experience with ASP.NET Core, Web APIs, Entity Framework Core and SQL Server.  
Experience working with Azure services including web applications, functions, databases, event hubs and storage.  
Strong understanding of testing practices, version control and Agile delivery methodologies.  
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.  
C1 level English proficiency or native-level fluency.  
STEM / Computer Science degree or equivalent evidence of advanced engineering capability and analytical problem-solving skills.  
Ability to work effectively in a fully remote environment.  

Desirable Experience

Search and indexing technologies.  
AI/ML-enabled products or AI-assisted development workflows.  
Distributed systems and scalability optimisation.  
Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines.  
REST API documentation, Swagger/OpenAPI.  
Duende Identity Server.  
Source generation in .NET.  
Exposure to frontend technologies, such as React, and full-stack development.  

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will demonstrate exceptional technical competence, strong communication skills, the ability to break down and solve complex challenges, intellectual curiosity, and a proactive approach to delivering meaningful outcomes for customers and colleagues.  

How we Work

Fully remote across the UK, Ireland or Spain. We meet in person a few times a year for team events, but day-to-day work is remote.  
Small, senior team. You will work directly with engineering leadership and have real input into technical decisions. 

Our Offer 

Guaranteed £2,000 (or local equivalent) pay rise every year you're with us, separate from any merit or promotion increases.

Time off and flexibility  
26 days holiday plus public holidays, with the option to swap public holidays for days that are more meaningful to you.  
Your birthday and work anniversary day off, every year.  
Up to 4 weeks per year working from anywhere in the world.  
Genuinely flexible, fully remote working - we trust you to manage your own time.  

Health, family, and wellbeing (UK employees)  
Generous Becoming a Parent leave, designed to support every kind of family.  
Medical scheme including remote GP, dental, optical, and diagnostics.  
Access to Support Room - confidential counselling, therapy, and coaching.  
Help@Hand employee assistance programme.  
5x salary life insurance through Unum.  

Money and growth   
Up to 10% pension match. (UK employees)  
Annual learning and development budget per function.
